about.title: Small and family owned
paragraphs: Daniel's Auto Repair is a small, family-owned shop in Tualatin. We're focused on a happy customer and a good running vehicle, and we stand behind our work with a warranty on all repairs.
Se habla español. And yes, the shop dog will probably come say hi.

estimate.title: What's going on with your car?
estimate.text: Tell us what your vehicle is doing and we will get back to you. Or call (503) 691-6306 (Mon–Fri: 8:30am–6pm).
estimate.thanks: Thanks! We will get back to you soon to set up a time.

services.intro: From small fixes to bigger mechanical repairs, we work on everyday cars and trucks and explain what your vehicle needs before we start.
